mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in FEDFUNDS over the next month signals tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative 20-day returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 4.5% in the next month signals a strong labor market, enhancing consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive despite UNRATE crossing 4.5%, or other variables offset the signal.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) signals robust economic expansion, increasing corporate profits and investor sentiment, driving positive 60-day returns.
failure_condition: Returns not positive when both GDPC1 and INDPRO rise simultaneously, or if one rises while the other falls.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, rising FEDFUNDS compresses discount rates, reducing equity valuations and generating negative 20-day returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative despite FEDFUNDS rising in the tightening cycle, or if other factors dominate.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained high INDPRO (supply growth) indicates robust production, boosting corporate profits and investor confidence, leading to positive 5-day returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO rises but 5-day returns not positive, or inflation offsets the supply growth signal.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in HOUST above 1300 indicates strong demand, enhancing corporate earnings and market optimism, driving positive 20-day returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive despite HOUST crossing 1300, or other demand factors are absent.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high labor demand (PAYEMS) and low unemployment (UNRATE) signal a robust labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive 60-day returns.
failure_condition: Returns not positive when both PAYEMS and UNRATE are high, or if one is high while the other is low.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion with sub-2% inflation, rising INDPRO signals approaching peak growth, leading to diminishing returns and negative 5-day S&P 500 moves.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not negative despite late-cycle conditions with sub-2% inflation, or if supply growth is not sustained.
